title: Hero Meeting presentation extraction
summary: Move the complete lower Hero Meeting army/artifact renderer, gesture state, split editor and accessibility into one component. Preserve native/JNI/actions and shared visual cache; cancel gestures on resize.
preparation: Verify the exact candidate receipt, is.xyz.vcmi.thor package and APK checksum. Install preserving data. Use a disposable game with two owned heroes, several creature stacks and movable/locked artifacts.
limitations: Presentation refactor only. Gameplay rules, upstream base and the retained no-custom-redistribution policy remain unchanged.

checks.title: Army transfer and exact split
checks.steps: Meet two owned heroes. Use stack tap, drag/drop, long-press split, amount adjustments, Cancel and Confirm, plus all available whole-army controls. Compare counts and required-last-stack behavior with the upper window.
checks.expected: All existing actions retain their behavior, count accuracy and native restrictions. One accepted action per gesture; no speculative game-state update.

checks.title: Artifacts and installed visuals
checks.steps: Switch modes, page all four artifact pages, tap/drag transfers and swaps, exercise whole-inventory controls and locked/full slots. Compare portraits, creature/artifact images and generic fallback with the upper window.
checks.expected: Current permitted slots only; page/selection highlights and visuals remain accurate. Invalid destinations stay inert; no unintended army action.

checks.title: Stale input and lifecycle
checks.steps: Hold a stack before long-press, switch context or change state on the upper display, then release. Repeat with artifact drag/split editor, extra pointers, background/resume, panel toggle/reconnect and display resize where available.
checks.expected: Old gestures and delayed callbacks cannot submit actions. Current snapshots restore once with no stale highlights, hit regions, duplicate presentation or focus loss.

checks.title: Parents and independent input
checks.steps: Close Meeting normally and return through Hero, Town, Adventure, resource trading and Battle decks. Use upper touch/controller throughout, repeat with the lower display unavailable and check system-respecting accepted-action haptics.
checks.expected: Native parent activation and all neighboring decks retain behavior; upper input and single-display play remain independent.
